tagline: 30 m from the sea, island of Pag
metaDesc: Apartment Rino in Košljun, island of Pag: sunny apartment 30 m from the sea with terrace, fenced garden, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi. Ideal for couples and families, pets welcome.
summary: Sunny and cosy apartment near the sea with a terrace and a fenced garden, ideal for couples and families.
body:
Sunny and cosy apartment situated near the sea. It consists of a well-equipped kitchen and living room with a large sofa which can be extended into a bed (160 x 200 cm), a flat-screen TV, the latest air conditioner, a twin-bedded room, a spacious bathroom with shower and washing machine, a nice terrace, a garden and free Wi-Fi.

The kitchen is equipped with an oven, stove, refrigerator and cooking basics: pots, pans, dishes, cutlery, a filter coffee maker and a kettle. Included in the rate: air conditioning, Wi-Fi, bed linen, bathroom towels, liquid soap, toilet paper and a hairdryer.

The terrace is equipped with garden furniture and a sunshade. The property is fenced and is therefore suitable for children and pets. The sea is approx. 30 m from the apartment.

If you like swimming, biking, diving, windsurfing, fishing and long walks, Apartment Rino in Košljun is an ideal choice for you.
goodToKnow:
The whole apartment, the terrace and a parking place near the apartment are available to guests.
A little grocery shop is 200 m from the apartment.
The tap water is safe for drinking.
A laundry line in the garden is at your disposal.
I’ll meet you for check-in and hand over the keys.
Grilling is not allowed in the backyard.
